name: Honda Gold Wing GL1200
engine: 1182 cc liquid-cooled flat four, timing belts, shaft drive
intro: A flat-four Gold Wing. Timing belts and the stator, which sits behind the engine, are the big jobs.

add.title: Replace the timing belts
add.instructions: If you can't prove the timing belts were changed in the last 10 years, replace them and the tensioners. Look at the water pump while the front cover is off.
add.reason: A snapped timing belt on these engines can bend valves.
add.src: The GS Resources Gold Wing thread

F: The stator sits at the back of the engine and the engine has to come out to change it. Test charging before you decide.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Timing belts
known.what: Replace them every 10 years or 100,000 miles, even if they look fine.
